A pierdut-o pe fata visurilor sale. Și ce faci cacirc;nd ești trist și ai o mașină a timpului? Cel mai probabil, ceva stupid. Eșuat intr-o realitate alternativă groaznică pe care o recunoaștem imediat drept anul 2016 al zilelor noastre , Tom e disperat să-și indrepte greșeala și să plece acasă. Pacirc;nă cacirc;nd descoperă, pe neașteptate, niște versiuni minunate ale familiei, carierei și femeii care poate fi iubirea vieții sale. Acum Tom se confruntă cu o alegere imposibilă. Să se intoarcă la viața sa perfectă, dar lipsită de dragoste, sau să rămacirc;nă in lumea noastră imperfectă, alături de iubita sa? Icirc;n căutarea răspunsului, Tom călătorește in spațiu și timp, in incercarea de a-și da seama, in sfacirc;rșit, cine este cu adevărat și care ar trebui să fie viitorul său și al nostru. bdquo;Un roman de debut surprinzător... # The Man Who Conquered Time by Litera

## Explore the Paradox of Time and Destiny

Dive into a mind-bending journey with *Omul care a cucerit timpul*, a captivating novel from Litera that explores the ultimate questions of time, regret, and alternate realities. This is more than just a story; it is an exploration of impossible choices and the complex nature of existence.

## The Journey Through Time

The story follows Tom Barren, a man who discovers that in the year 2016, technology has solved all human problemsâno war, no poverty, no avocado shortage. Yet, despite this perfect reality, Tom is deeply unhappy, having lost the love of his life. Armed with a time machine, he seeks to fix his mistake and return home.

But as Tom travels through space and time, he unexpectedly encounters stunning alternate versions of his family, career, and the woman he loves. He faces an impossible choice: return to a perfect but loveless life, or stay in our imperfect world alongside his beloved. In this quest for answers, Tom must confront who he truly is, what the future should be, and what defines reality itself.

## A Literary Masterpiece

Critics have recognized this novel for its unique narrative voice and complex themes:

> "A novel about the journey in time has no right to be attacked by the instructor. A novel attacked by the instructor has no right to be attacked by the intelligent. And a novel attacked by the intelligent has no right to be attacked by the amusing. Or the perplexing. Or the captivating. In fact, this novel has no right to exist." â Jonathan Tropper

Experience a story that is simultaneously hilarious, profound, and deeply moving, offering a unique perspective on fate and human connection.
